item.title: Storage Knowledge Every Operations Engineer Should Know
item.description: 1 Volatile Memory 1.1 REG REG (Register) is a storage unit inside the CPU, sitting right next to the arithmetic unit — the fastest and smallest level of the storage hierarchy. General-purpose registers (RAX/RBX/RDI on x86, and so on) take part directly in instruction execution, with access latency around 0.2–0.5 ns (roughly one clock cycle), lost on power loss, and typically only tens to hundreds of bytes.
